_about: DEMO: food delivery orders from examples/demo. Try ws-mock here before setting up your own app.
_fields: The field map: what each field of an order does on the screen. The presets below are built from it.

fields.status: status badge and colour: placed | preparing | on_the_way | delivered | cancelled (spec)
fields.courier.name: courier line under the badge, while on_the_way; null = no courier (spec)
fields.total.amount: price line; no total = no price (spec)
fields.cta: button text; missing = default for the status (spec)
